concept: Thinking ahead about what might happen before you act
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character thinks ahead about a few different ways a game or task could go before choosing their move
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did thinking ahead help the character avoid or achieve?
exercise.practice: Student plays a simple 'what happens next' game, predicting outcomes before choosing

assessment.success_marker: student makes at least one genuine prediction before acting, rather than just reacting
